integrity: Analytic infinite-class theorem; independently checked finite-state ODE formulas via 217 program assertions. No external audit or full priority certification. Main motivating paper inspected in HTML; ancillary supplement not exhaustively inspected.
limitations: Applies to isolated three-person SIR groups, unit exponential recovery, initially one infective, nondegenerate compactly supported positive group-level transmission heterogeneity, and at-risk-pair weighting. No result for overlapping groups, unique reversal time, or empirical finite-sample power.
title: A universal early-to-late reversal in apparent contagion for three-person SIR groups
